octia.create_world.toggle.tooltip: Whether Octia is active in this world. Decided now and fixed for the life of the save. When on, a lit mast stands at spawn the moment the world opens, a derelict lies within a short walk of it, and andesite ruins are scattered out through the world for you to find.
octia.crew.none: Nobody is aboard. /octia crew muster seats the bench.
octia.crew.no_muster: The crew is not up yet; the server has only just started.
octia.crew.bench.silent: Bench silent: %s. The crew runs on the offline tender.
octia.crew.seated.tender: %s takes a seat on the offline tender
octia.crew.nothing_to_muster: Nothing to muster: no endpoint answered and the roster in config/octia-crew.json is empty. Seat one by hand with /octia crew summon <name>.
octia.crew.taken: %s is already aboard, or that name is in use.
octia.crew.full: The crew is full at %s. Raise max_crew in config/octia-crew.json.
octia.crew.bad_name: %s is not a name a player can have: at most %s characters, letters, digits, and underscore.
